decisions.reason: The cover's use of accurate final page numbers is already independently established by the same message, so the table-of-contents update adds no missing state.
Finalized table-of-contents page numbers do not change the policy for eliminating empty white areas at article endings.
The table-of-contents pagination update does not alter the requirement that the flipbook layout work as balanced two-page spreads.
Correcting table-of-contents page references does not change the selected body font or its required visual treatment.
Final pagination does not change the required article categories, mappings, label style, or placement.
The table-of-contents page-number decision does not affect the requirement that advertisements render clearly.
Using finalized pagination for the table of contents does not change which cover-mentioned articles must be included or how their placement is determined.
The table-of-contents correction relies on the completed layout but does not modify the issue assembly behavior or Flat Plan reference.
Finalized article page numbers do not change author-name, author-photo, source, matching, or placement requirements.
The table-of-contents update does not alter the digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
Correct table-of-contents pagination does not change the requirement to enhance publication images when necessary.
The table-of-contents page-number update neither resumes nor changes the deferred print-ready output requirement.
